overview_description.description: Taaleem is an education services company headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The company develops and manages early childhood, primary, and secondary schools across the UAE. Its schools provide international curricula including British, American, International Baccalaureate (IB), and multilingual early education programs.
